title: docs/DNS.md is stale
description:
**Problem**
docs/DNS.md no longer matches the current hostnames and records.

**Evidence**
docs/DNS.md versus `dig` for aurit.us, hear.aurit.us and console.aurit.us (see the console.aurit.us DNS bug).

**Fix**
Update docs/DNS.md to the current record set, after deciding the console hostname.

**How to verify**
Every hostname in docs/DNS.md resolves as described.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
